posts.meta_description:
2,186 likes, 155 comments - amanda_doesdonuts on October 14, 2026: "I’ve spent the last 11 years building things I didn’t know how to build yet.

I grew up in a family where if you didn’t know how to do something, you figured it out. That mindset took me from starting @thesaltydonut out of a vintage camper to building a company across the country.
 
The one problem I could not solve for years was forecasting. One shop would sell out by 10 AM while another threw trays away at close, because everybody was guessing. There was no tool out there that worked the way our business works. So I mapped out exactly what we needed and worked with a developer to build it using @microsoft 
 
Today every shop plans production with it. Better decisions, less waste, happier guests.

You don’t have to know how to build something to know it should exist. You just have to know the problem, believe there is a better way, and find the right people and tools to help you build it.
 
You’re capable of building more than you think. What’s a leap of faith you took before you had it all figured out? #MicrosoftPartner".
